marketSummary: Indian equities are navigating range-bound consolidation around the 23,100 Nifty baseline as aggressive FII outflows (net selling over ₹11,490 crore for the week) encounter counter-cyclical absorption from DIIs (net purchases exceeding ₹16,398 crore). dailyFocus: Monitor base-breakout follow-through in electricals and transmission plays (CGPOWER) against overhead supply, track delivery execution triggers in defence majors (HAL, BEL), and observe support tests in heavily corrected large-cap growth setups (TRENT).

news.headline: FIIs Pull Out ₹11,490 Crore in 6th Selling Week; DII Inflows of ₹16,398 Crore Provide Cushion
news.summary: Foreign institutional investors extended their sustained equity liquidation streak, pulling out a net ₹11,490 crore over the week (taking MTD outflows past ₹18,531 crore) pressured by high US 10-year Treasury yields and firm crude oil. Conversely, domestic institutions countered with ₹16,398 crore of net buying, preventing a breakdown below the 23,050 support pivot.
news.impact: Polarized institutional liquidity keeps headline index breakouts suppressed while confining high-beta swing opportunities to resilient sector outliers.

news.headline: Trent Extends Pullback Toward Support Zones Following Valuation Compression
news.summary: Trent traded lower to multi-week support around the ₹2,660-₹2,700 band, confirming a breakdown below its 20- and 50-day moving averages. Sustained foreign fund selling in high-multiple discretionary plays alongside Tata-group related boardroom overhangs has kept follow-through buying subdued since the Q1 business update missed elevated street expectations.
news.impact: Violation of primary short-term moving averages shifts swing setups into risk-off mode until a clear bottoming base and volume dry-up materialize.

news.headline: CG Power Exhibits Volume Breakout Driven by AI Power Infrastructure Demand & OSAT Ramp
news.summary: CG Power traded with heavy above-average turnover, demonstrating high relative strength against benchmark weakness. The stock is benefiting from structural demand in transformer and switchgear equipment tied to global data-center electrification, along with operational milestones at its Sanand OSAT semiconductor unit; Motilal Oswal reiterates a ₹1,020 target.
news.impact: Decisive outperformance on elevated volume signals active institutional accumulation, positioning the stock near the top of pivot-breakout watchlists.

news.headline: HAL Handover of 3 Platforms & Engine Inflow Eases LCA Mk1A Execution Bottlenecks
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics delivered 3 aerospace platforms to the Indian Air Force as GE handed over an additional three F404 aero-engines for the LCA Mk1A program. Goldman Sachs noted that delivery constraints are structurally easing, pivoting the company's focus toward rapid conversion of its multi-year order backlog into revenue.
news.impact: Supply chain clarity eliminates key execution discount, aiding price consolidation along the rising 50-day average for a potential retest of range highs.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures ₹648 Crore In Fresh Contracts, Inflow Run-Rate Accelerates
news.summary: Bharat Electronics disclosed fresh contract wins totaling ₹648 crore since late August, comprising laser-based infrared jammers, communication equipment, cyber systems, and AI-driven defense software. This takes BEL's cumulative order inflows since July 31 to approximately ₹2,766 crore, reinforcing its ₹72,258 crore order book.
news.impact: Steady contract cadence provides liquidity absorption and supports re-accumulation near multi-week support bands for base-building setups.

news.headline: Welspun Corp Subsidiary Bags Landmark $412.5M HFIW Pipe Order in the United States
news.summary: Welspun Corp's US-based arm secured a major contract valued at approximately $412.5 million (approx ₹3,450 crore) for high-frequency induction welded (HFIW) pipes and coating solutions, bolstering order book visibility over FY27-FY28 and driving strong buying interest.
news.impact: Large contract award triggers an immediate multi-week range breakout on heavy volume, creating a prime candidate for pullback-to-breakout retest setups.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Signs JV with Drydocks World Amid Post-Guidance Consolidation
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard executed a formal Joint Venture Agreement with Drydocks World (DDW) to expand commercial vessel repair operations. The stock has undergone a 12% price correction over recent sessions after management guided toward moderate EBITDA margins over the next two fiscal years despite a healthy ₹22,000 crore order pipeline.
news.impact: Margin recalibration has induced institutional repricing; traders should wait for price discovery and base stability around intermediate support before anticipating cup-or-vcp structures.

news.headline: GIFT Nifty Clocks Record Single-Day Turnover of $21.18 Billion with Peak Open Interest
news.summary: GIFT Nifty achieved an all-time single-day trading high of 457,999 contracts valued at $21.18 billion on September 24 at NSE IX, alongside record open interest. Market participants cite increased institutional derivatives positioning and synthetic hedging ahead of the upcoming monthly contracts expiry.
news.impact: Record derivative turnover highlights heightened positioning, signaling elevated intraday volatility and potential whipsaws around benchmark support bands.

news.headline: Ola Electric Mobility Schedules Board Meeting for Capital Raising on September 28
news.summary: Ola Electric Mobility notified exchanges under Regulation 29 that its board will convene on September 28, 2026, to deliberate on raising funds through equity shares, convertible instruments, or private placement avenues, addressing working capital requirements and expansion plans.
news.impact: Potential dilution overhang may limit upside continuation, requiring swing traders to observe post-announcement structural structure rather than chasing early spikes.

news.headline: Transport Corporation of India Board to Consider Share Buyback on September 29
news.summary: Transport Corporation of India informed exchanges that a meeting of its Board of Directors is scheduled for Tuesday, September 29, 2026, to consider and approve a proposal for the buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. The announcement prompted strong accumulation in preceding trading sessions.
news.impact: Buyback intimation sets a concrete price-support floor and could trigger a pre-event volatility expansion across consolidation highs.
